_readme: TUNING [rule 117 in the table] 10/18 (rule 117 EASIER THAN BATTLE BROTHERS, Paolo 10/18 on TUNING's numbers card: 'I want you to be easier than Battle Brothers... Nintendo simplified... minimalist... make the people feel that they're successfully doing it'; rule 38g research only; rule 21 one numbers table). draft:true. NOTHING IN THE GAME READS THIS FILE. A modder can edit it: every lever is one object. tools/bohemia_tuning_one_table_seed.js folds it into the one table: each row gets a rule_117 mark. A LEVER is a felt number with a harder and an easier way; it carries Battle Brothers' value (the HARD END of its slider, rule 117a), our proposed START (easier), the slider from start to hard end and past it, whether the number is SHOWN on the screen or lives UNDER the surface (rule 117b), and the WIN the player sees or hears when he gets it right (rule 117c). A row that is not a lever gets the mark of its family (families below). Record: records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_RULE_117_EVERY_FELT_NUMBER_STARTS_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_10_18_26.md

marks.EASIER: a lever: our start is easier than Battle Brothers' value, which is the hard end of the slider
marks.ALREADY EASIER: his ruling or our design is already easier than Battle Brothers; it stays, and Battle Brothers' number is the hard end
marks.HARDER THAN BB: today the game is HARDER than Battle Brothers on this number without his word: a NO before he sees it (rule 117, last line); the owner moves it to the start named. Measured by machine from 10/18 (records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MEASURED_10_18_26.md)
marks.HELD AT BB, BOTH SIDES: the same rule for him and for them (a hit chance, a cost, a weapon row); held at Battle Brothers' value; the easier comes from the levers, never from bending a shared rule
marks.NOT A HARDNESS NUMBER: the shape of the game (a look, a board size, a beat, a list of names); rule 117 does not move it
marks.PRICE, FRIENDLY END: a price or a pay: ECONOMY owns the number; rule 117 says it starts at the friendly end of Battle Brothers' range

levers.bb: Veteran 0; Beginner: your roll 5 better, the enemy's 5 worse (wiki, Game Mechanics: Difficulty levels; records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_THE_DIFFICULTY_STEPS_EXACTLY_10_9_26.md s2)
levers.way: points added to your hit chance and taken off theirs
levers.shown: SHOWN inside the hit number (the number on the tile is the true number, the help is already in it)
levers.win: more of your swings land: the hit sound and the man staggering
levers.why: Battle Brothers' own Beginner is our default; their Veteran is our hard end, their Expert sits past it

levers.bb: Battle Brothers has none: every roll is clean
levers.way: after one of your men misses a shot of 50 or better, his next such shot gets +10 until one lands
levers.shown: SHOWN inside the hit number
levers.win: a bad streak ends: the streak never runs three long on a good shot
levers.why: Battle Brothers has no help: every roll is clean. A 50-plus shot that misses three times running is the miss a player blames the dice for; measured on the live fight (records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MEASURED_10_18_26.md s2), the help cuts those streaks, and it sits inside the shown number so the tile never lies

levers.bb: Beginner 0.85 of the resources an enemy party is built from; Veteran 1.0; Expert harder groups sooner (players' read of the game files; wiki: 'higher combat difficulty means harder enemy groups appear sooner')
levers.way: the party is sized at this share of the job math (records/target/bb/party_math.json difficulty_count_mult: the door's 'new' pick is 0.85 already; the door opens on 'seen', 1.0). The fixed first band of nine is already the Beginner count for the twelve (ten at Veteran)
levers.shown: UNDER the surface (he sees fewer men, never the number)
levers.win: you outnumber them more often: the fight ends inside the 2 to 4 minutes he set
levers.owner: RUN (the door opens on new) + COMBAT (the first fight sized by the job math)
levers.why: Battle Brothers moves difficulty through the COUNT of the enemy, not their stats (wiki: 'enemies carry the same equipment with the same stats on all difficulty levels'); we do the same

levers.bb: Beginner: the late crisis 5 days later and easier groups later; Expert: harder groups sooner
levers.bb_value: difficulty_days [0,0,20,40]: the first two steps add nothing
levers.start: the middle phase from day 25 (was 20) and the late phase from day 75 (was 60) at the default; difficulty_days [-5,0,20,40] so the easiest step is later still
slider: the table as it stands (Battle Brothers' pace)
levers.way: how soon the better-armed crews show up
levers.shown: UNDER the surface
levers.win: the early acts have time to feel like you are winning before the world catches up
levers.why: Beginner's +5 days, made a quarter of the phase, because our phases are counted in our own days

levers.bb: -0.15 on every gain (wiki, Level and Experience); Beginner adds +10% for every character
levers.way: how fast a man levels
levers.shown: UNDER the surface; the level-up itself is SHOWN
levers.win: a level-up every two or three fights early on: the man's sound and his one new thing
levers.why: Beginner's +10% on Battle Brothers' own number

levers.bb: a struck-down man lives 33 in 100, so 67 die (injuries_and_death.struck_down_survival_chance)
levers.way: how often a man at zero dies
levers.shown: SHOWN once, in the words of the man who saw it fall
levers.win: four in five come back with a scar and a story
levers.why: his number stands; it is a third of Battle Brothers'. Battle Brothers' 0.67 is the far end of the stakes slider

levers.bb: 0.67 for everyone (no veteran rule in Battle Brothers)
levers.way: how often a veteran at zero dies (superseded: every man rolls the flat 0.20)
levers.shown: UNDER the surface
levers.win: the men you kept alive stay alive
levers.owner: nobody reads it on purpose; COMBAT holds the flat roll
levers.why: the fifth votes' flat 0.20 (10/1) is newer than the third votes' 0.10 (9/28) and rules (COMBAT 10/18); 0.20 is under Battle Brothers' 0.67, so the row is EASIER, and last round's HARDER THAN BB mark was wrong (records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MEASURED_10_18_26.md s3.2)

levers.bb: in Battle Brothers anyone dies, the captain too (the run ends on some origins)
levers.way: whether you can die
levers.shown: never a number
levers.win: you are always the one who gets back up
levers.why: his ruling; no slider moves it

levers.bb: Battle Brothers' struck-down survivor carries a PERMANENT injury for good
levers.way: how long the mark keeps him off the field
levers.shown: SHOWN as days on his row in the roster
levers.win: he comes back; the clinic halves it
levers.why: his days stand; Battle Brothers' permanent is the hard end

levers.bb: 15 a turn (wiki, Combat Mechanics)
levers.way: breath back each turn, YOUR men only (theirs keep Battle Brothers' 15)
levers.shown: UNDER the surface: a breath bar, never the number (rule 117b)
levers.win: a man can swing one more time before he is spent
levers.why: measured (records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MEASURED_10_18_26.md s3.4): 18 for both sides is a shared rule bent and buys almost nothing, because they breathe more too; 18 for his men only is the lever

levers.bb: Battle Brothers' morale is the same rule for both sides (parsed.morale_enemy_dies, morale.state_multipliers)
levers.way: the enemy's resolve is multiplied by this, so a losing crew breaks and runs a little sooner
levers.shown: SHOWN as the rout: men turning and running
levers.win: THE ROUT: the fight ends with them running from you, the loudest win in the game
levers.why: the shared morale rule stays at Battle Brothers' (held both sides); the lever sits on the enemy's resolve stat, the way Battle Brothers sets enemies by their rows

levers.bb: stars on THREE attributes, raising level-ups (wiki, Talents)
levers.way: how many of a hired man's stats carry stars
levers.harder_today: the hire screen stars ONE stat and applies it to his starting roll (TUNING [the settlement's numbers] finding): a hired man is worth less than a Battle Brothers recruit
levers.shown: SHOWN as the stars
levers.win: a man with three stars is a find, and you see it at the hall
levers.why: three is Battle Brothers' floor; going under it is harder than Battle Brothers

levers.bb: one star 60, two 30, three 10 in 100 (wiki, Talents)
levers.way: how many stars a starred stat gets
levers.shown: SHOWN as the stars
levers.win: a three-star stat one hire in seven instead of one in ten
levers.why: my recruit odds page (10/10): 36 killers should be as hard as Battle Brothers' 12; a fifth more stars at the top gets most of the way

levers.bb: one star 60, two 30, three 10 in 100
levers.way: the starting crew's star roll, same as the hire's
levers.shown: SHOWN as the stars
levers.win: the crew you start with has a man worth keeping
levers.why: one roll for both, rule 117 start

levers.bb: the Game Guide's observed prices include gear and level; the formula (engine/bohemia_pricetable.js) gives a level-one militiaman 49 batteries
levers.way: what a hire costs
levers.harder_today: the hall asks up to 225 batteries (2248 crowns): four and a half times the formula (TUNING [the settlement's numbers] finding)
levers.shown: SHOWN as the price
levers.win: you can afford the man you want after one good contract
levers.why: load the price file the screen does not load, then four fifths of it

levers.bb: a hall pays 13.6 to 19.7 in 100 of an item's worth by size and relation (price_table.json, the wiki); Expert 10 lower
levers.way: what a settlement pays you for loot
levers.shown: SHOWN as one price per item
levers.win: loot is worth carrying home: a fifth of its worth, every time
levers.why: the friendly end of Battle Brothers' own range (a city that likes you, 19.7) as the start; today's 1/7 is their town at neutral

levers.bb: A New Crew, the door's default origin: High 2900, Medium 2400, Low 1900 crowns (records/target/bb/origins.json, the wiki's origin page); the door's default 'thin' IS the Medium
levers.way: batteries you start with: the door's economy pick, 'full' (their High) at the start, 'thin' (their Medium) the hard end
levers.shown: SHOWN as the one battery count
levers.win: the first trip to the market feels rich
levers.why: Battle Brothers' High is our start; their Medium, the door's default today, is the hard end (records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MEASURED_10_18_26.md s3.3)

levers.bb: Beginner tools 200, ammo 500, medicine 150; Veteran and Expert 150, 300, 100 (wiki)
levers.way: how much of each supply the wagon holds
levers.shown: UNDER the surface until it is nearly full
levers.win: you rarely leave a battery on the ground
levers.why: Beginner's caps are the start

levers.bb: 100 / 100 / 90 in 100 (Game Guide)
levers.way: what a contract pays
levers.shown: SHOWN as the skulls and the pay
levers.win: the pay is the number on the poster
levers.why: Battle Brothers pays the same on its two lower steps; there is nothing friendlier in their range to start from, and inventing one is ECONOMY's call

levers.bb: the wiki gives no day count; one unpaid day a band, a content hire is angry by day 3 (my mood page, 10/10)
levers.way: unpaid days before a man walks
levers.shown: SHOWN as his face going sour, a day before he goes
levers.win: you always get one warning and one day to pay him
levers.why: his 'a couple of days' from Grok's read, given two more days and a warning so it never feels like a trap

levers.bb: 3 to 35 crowns a day per man (backgrounds.json daily_wage)
levers.way: a wage
levers.shown: never a number while it is zero
levers.win: a man is bought once
levers.owner: paolo (bought once is the ruling over the wage)
levers.why: his ruling

levers.bb: 5 to 95 (wiki, Hit Chance)
levers.way: no shot is ever sure
levers.shown: SHOWN in the hit number
levers.win: a 95 lands 19 in 20 and the help (combat.miss_streak_help) makes the twentieth rare
levers.why: kept: a sure thing is a chess puzzle again (rule 37: quicker, less of a chess puzzle)

levers.bb: Battle Brothers' men never age; the hard end is the REAL curve's bad luck (Gompertz-Makeham): crash 0.005, hard 0.002, good 0.0005 a year
levers.way: a flat yearly chance a named person dies of 'age' at any age
levers.shown: UNDER the surface
levers.win: no one dies of age young, out of nowhere: at the real curve's bad luck 46 in 100 deaths of 'age' land before 60
levers.why: records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_HOW_LONG_A_LIFE_IS_THREE_SETS_ACROSS_THREE_ACTS_10_18_26.md (measured by tools/bohemia_tuning_lifespans_sim.js)

levers.bb: the real curve: crash 1.8, hard 1.3, good 1.0 times the base risk (Russia 1990-94: men 25 to 64 carried the loss, Notzon et al., JAMA 1998)
levers.way: how much the times multiply the yearly risk of dying of age
levers.shown: UNDER the surface; the times show in the faces
levers.win: 80 in 100 people you meet at 40 are there in the next act (the real curve: 55)
levers.why: records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_HOW_LONG_A_LIFE_IS_THREE_SETS_ACROSS_THREE_ACTS_10_18_26.md (measured by tools/bohemia_tuning_lifespans_sim.js)

levers.bb: the real curve has no floor
levers.way: nobody named dies of age before this age
levers.shown: never a number
levers.win: a death of age is always an old person's, so it reads as a life and not a dice roll
levers.why: records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_HOW_LONG_A_LIFE_IS_THREE_SETS_ACROSS_THREE_ACTS_10_18_26.md (measured by tools/bohemia_tuning_lifespans_sim.js)

levers.bb: none in Battle Brothers; RimWorld and Crusader Kings show age in the body first (a genre study)
levers.way: the yearly risk at which the body shows it (the stoop, the cough, the grey at the barber)
levers.shown: SHOWN as the body, never a number
levers.win: you always see it coming at least one act before
levers.why: records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_HOW_LONG_A_LIFE_IS_THREE_SETS_ACROSS_THREE_ACTS_10_18_26.md (measured by tools/bohemia_tuning_lifespans_sim.js)

levers.bb: Veteran, Battle Brothers' default
levers.way: the start screen's combat pick, as the door opens
levers.today: the door opens on 'seen', Battle Brothers' Veteran: as hard as Battle Brothers by default (records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MEASURED_10_18_26.md s3.3)
levers.shown: SHOWN on the door (one word)
levers.win: the first fights end with your men still standing
levers.why: rule 117a: Battle Brothers' default sits at our hard end, so ours opens one step easier

levers.bb: Medium funds, Battle Brothers' default
levers.way: the start screen's economy pick, as the door opens
levers.today: the door opens on 'thin', Battle Brothers' Medium (records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MEASURED_10_18_26.md s3.3)
levers.shown: SHOWN on the door (one word)
levers.win: the first market feels rich
levers.why: rule 117a, the same as the combat pick

levers.bb: three stats a level (wiki, Level and Experience: melee skill and defence 1 to 4, ranged skill, hp, breath and nerve 2 to 5, initiative 3 to 6)
levers.way: a level-up makes his man stronger in the fight
levers.harder_today: the fight rolls every man fresh from his background and his level only picks his perks, while the map adds two strength a level to size the enemy: every level makes the enemy bigger and his men no better (records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MEASURED_10_18_26.md s3.1)
levers.shown: SHOWN as the level-up (the stars rise)
levers.win: the men you kept alive are visibly better
levers.owner: COMBAT (crewUnit) + RUN TWO (the roster hands the stats)
levers.why: Battle Brothers' own rule; going under it is harder than Battle Brothers

levers.bb: 29 batteries by the wiki's formula (engine/bohemia_pricetable.js, base plus 1.25 x the kit)
levers.way: what a cheap hire costs
levers.harder_today: the hall asks up to 41 batteries; the formula gives 29 (TUNING [the settlement's numbers] finding)
levers.shown: SHOWN as the price
levers.win: a cheap man is cheap
levers.why: four fifths of the formula, the same as the militiaman

levers.bb: 1.0: your men break at their own resolve
levers.way: your men's nerve (their resolve x this)
levers.shown: UNDER the surface (fewer of his men run)
levers.win: your line holds when theirs breaks
levers.owner: COMBAT builds; PEOPLE (who breaks); TUNING holds
levers.why: rule 117's set eased their nerve and not his; measured (records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_EASIER_THAN_BATTLE_BROTHERS_MEASURED_10_18_26.md s3.6)

shown_rule._why: rule 117b, Nintendo-simple (his word, 10/18): fewer numbers on the screen. Battle Brothers itself shows the hit chance on the tile and the bars and keeps the maths in a tooltip; we show less than that, never a number that is not the real one
SHOWN: the hit chance on the tile
his hp and armour as two bars
UNDER: fatigue as a number (a breath bar instead)
morale as a number (one face instead)
initiative and the turn order maths

families.note: the first crew you meet: its size is moved by the lever ours.band_size_mult (0.85 at the start, Battle Brothers' 1.0 at the hard end)
his fifth vote (rule 56): 0.20 plus 0.05 a mark carried; even at four marks (0.40) it is under Battle Brothers' 0.67
the shape of the game or his ruling on it
a row is the same in his hand and in theirs; the easier comes from the levers (Battle Brothers keeps gear stats fixed across difficulty, wiki)
Battle Brothers keeps enemy stats fixed across difficulty and moves the count; ours.band_size_mult and ours.enemy_nerve are the levers
the same rule for both sides; held at Battle Brothers'
ECONOMY and RUN TWO own the number; start at the friendly end of Battle Brothers' range
the company's numbers: PEOPLE and RUN TWO; start at the friendly end
